summary.headline: Vaticanus 318 Manuscript Contents
summary.text: Lists chapters of the twelve-place system of katarchai on travel, voyages, return from abroad, vows, residence changes, letters, practical questions, and stellar effects. Begins the description of Vaticanus 318, formerly Cardinal Ottoboni’s, with its manuscript details and works by Geminus, Pappus, Ptolemy, and Theophilus, including astrolabe construction and lunar anomaly.
